title: studio(interfaces): after a refused leaf save, the red "Changes not saved" strip stays on screen once a later save goes through — InterfacesPillar's doSave never clears its error
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, class (a), a stale refusal at a public surface, measured. Reach: Studio → a writable package → Interfaces → any leaf (dashboard, report, page). A leaf autosave the draft door refuses, then an edit whose save goes through: the red strip stays. Reader: objectui triage first-touch (grade and route).

Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open and closed):
- The query "Studio Interfaces dashboard leaf red Changes not saved strip stays after a later save succeeds" returned 13 hits. None describes this. The nearest are objectui#11786 (the held-edit family) and objectui#11910 (an unbound widget refused at once).
- Positive control, same run: that query returned objectui#11910: yes.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 3 (`session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`) from the objectui#11910 dev report (`6056984755`, out-of-scope finding 1, PR objectui#11948). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What happens

- **Measured by the dev.** A probe drove the real `InterfacesPillar` against a client double: one refused leaf save, then a successful one. The strip was still present after the second save. The probe was not committed. Not measured against a live server.
- **Read by the seat** in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` on objectui `main` `f3a0488`:
  - `InterfacesPillar`'s leaf `doSave` (about `:3234`–`:3256`) sets `error` in its `catch` and never clears it.
  - The pillar clears `error` only when a leaf (re)loads (about `:3172`).
  - The Data pillar's `doSave` (about `:4834`–`:4837`) and the Automations pillar's (about `:6035`–`:6038`) call `setError(null)` at the start of each save.
- So the strip keeps saying "the server refused this draft" after the draft has been saved, until the author leaves the leaf.

## Done when

- A leaf save that goes through clears the leaf's refusal, as the other two pillars do.
- A pin: a refused save, then a successful one, leaves no strip. Control: a second refused save still shows its own refusal.
